title: carex atrata subsp. perfusca
intro: Carex atrata subsp. perfusca, commonly known as Purple Sedge or False Cottongrass, is a subspecies of sedge that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, contributing to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Carex atrata subsp. perfusca include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
